children.value: Explore R’s built-in iris dataset and calculate averages by species.

children.label: Explore R’s built-in iris dataset and calculate averages by species.

children.value:
head(iris)

summary_by_species <- iris |>
  group_by(Species) |>
  summarise(
    samples = n(),
    mean_petal_length = mean(Petal.Length),
    mean_petal_width = mean(Petal.Width),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_by_species

children.value: Filter flower measurements and compare species in a scatter plot.

children.label: Filter flower measurements and compare species in a scatter plot.

children.value:
iris |>
  filter(Petal.Length > 2) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = Petal.Length,
    y = Petal.Width,
    colour = Species
  )) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(
    title = "Flower measurements",
    x = "Petal length (cm)",
    y = "Petal width (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
Read counties bundled with sf, reproject, and calculate their areas.

children.label: Read counties bundled with sf, reproject, and calculate their areas.

children.value:
counties <- st_read(
  system.file("gpkg/nc.gpkg", package = "sf"),
  quiet = TRUE
) |>
  st_transform(5070)

counties$area_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(counties)) / 1e6

counties |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  dplyr::select(NAME, area_km2) |>
  arrange(desc(area_km2)) |>
  head()

  geom_sf(aes(fill = area_km2), colour = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Area (km²)") +
  labs(title = "North Carolina counties") +
  theme_minimal()
Convert R’s built-in volcano elevation matrix into a raster on a local 10 m grid.

children.label: Convert R’s built-in volcano elevation matrix into a raster on a local 10 m grid.

children.value:
elevation <- rast(
  nrows = nrow(volcano),
  ncols = ncol(volcano),
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = ncol(volcano) * 10,
  ymin = 0,
  ymax = nrow(volcano) * 10,
  crs = ""
)

values(elevation) <- as.vector(t(volcano))
names(elevation) <- "elevation"

plot(elevation, main = "Example terrain elevation (m)")
Summarize elevations and identify cells above 150 m.

children.label: Summarize elevations and identify cells above 150 m.

children.value:
# Summarize elevation across the raster
global(elevation, fun = c("min", "mean", "max"), na.rm = TRUE)

# Identify cells higher than 150 metres
high_ground <- elevation > 150

plot(
  high_ground,
  main = "Terrain above 150 m",
  col = c("lightgrey", "darkgreen")
)
